verdict.rationale: Evidence only covers Notion's REST API, webhooks, and OAuth integrations, all of which require coding/scripting (PATs for 'scripts, CLI workflows'), plus vague marketing about 'agents' and 'system of record' — none describe a native no-code, multi-step automation builder a PM could use without writing code. Missing for 10: documentation of Notion's built-in automation/button/database-trigger no-code feature, PM-oriented walkthroughs, or independent hands-on validation of no-code automation building.
